title: Solana guarded swapper (plain TypeScript)
summary: Watches a Solana wallet and, when the SOL price falls past a threshold, prepares a Jupiter SOL to USDC swap under a daily cap from policy.json. It uses the Sato Kit's Solana actions (solana.read, solana.swap.quote, solana.swap.prepare), simulates the unsigned transaction with simulateTransaction, runs the policy pre-flight, and stops at an unsigned transaction: there is no signer and nothing is broadcast. Fixture mode needs no network and no key. `npm run preflight` checks each installed dependency against its Sato Check receipt on Solana.

tests.description: The platform runs the fixture command over the shipped recordings (no network, no key) and checks out/report.json against schemas/output.json: exit 0, one unsigned transaction written, the same swap once the day's room is used up refused by the daily cap, and an oversized swap refused by the per-swap cap, each with its rule, limit and observed value.
The template's own tests, including npm run preflight against a mocked Solana RPC, a mocked receipts API and mocked tarballs. Recorded, never the verdict.

provenance.notes: Deterministic over fixtures recorded on Solana mainnet-beta (public RPC, Jupiter, Sato Route). The live mode is opt-in and never runs in the platform's offline test phase. No mode has a signer.
